ThingDef.label: liberty cap
ThingDef.description: A small mushroom with a pointed cap and psychoactive effects. Can be eaten directly or used in ordinary meals. Counts as fungus. A first standard exposure (10 mushrooms) grants +15 mood for 6 hours and causes 6–8 hours of uncontrolled hallucination wandering. These effects also occur when used as a meal ingredient. Psychoactive mushroom mood bonuses do not stack with each other. Amount affects mood and duration; new episodes are scheduled for 6–24 hours. Repeated intake cannot extend an episode beyond 24 hours from first exposure. Sleep or incapacitation can end wandering early.
